Acquisition and activation strategy from discovery to first export.

Role

Growth audit and funnel planning

Period

Incuse client engagement

Scope

Proposed plan · SEO · CRO · Lifecycle · Paid media · Messaging

01

Executive Summary

Through Incuse, I audited AutoReel’s search visibility, messaging, paid media, lifecycle activity and conversion path. The resulting 90-day proposal prioritizes discovery, first upload, export and upgrade.

02

Situation

Examine how the journey from listing photos to a finished video could make the value of exporting or upgrading easier to understand.

03

Task

Find where people were losing the path from discovery to first export and upgrade, then set out a 90-day plan for those gaps.

04

Action

  1. Review discovery

    Assessed audience, messaging and acquisition opportunities.

  2. Map activation

    Examined upload, generation, preview, export and upgrade as distinct steps.

  3. Prioritize the plan

    Proposed a phased approach to measurement, conversion testing and focused acquisition.

05

Result

Deliverable: a growth audit and phased 90-day funnel plan. Implementation has not begun, so no performance result is reported.

Selected materials

Growth audit
and 90-day plan.

Proposed strategy; implementation and results are not claimed.

Strategic insight

The roadmap treats acquisition, first use and paid conversion as separate stages with distinct measures.
